sections.label: YOU WIN IF
items: You are elected Chancellor after 3 Fascist policies.

sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: Only the Fascist, when there is just one.
Otherwise nobody: show your thumb at setup.

sections.label: YOU MUST
items: Say that you are Hitler when executed, or when elected Chancellor after 3 Fascist policies.

sections.label: GOOD TO KNOW
items: A Bodyguard dies in your place, once.

details.label: Goal
text: You lead the Fascist team. You win when the Fascist board is full or when you are elected Chancellor after the 3rd Fascist policy.

details.label: What you know
text: Usually nobody. At setup you keep your eyes closed and show a thumb, so the Fascists learn who you are, but you do not learn who they are. Only when there is exactly one Fascist do the two of you open your eyes together.

details.label: You must tell the truth
text: If you are executed, or if you are elected Chancellor after 3 Fascist policies, you must say that you are Hitler. These are the only moments in the game when a player may not lie.

details.label: Danger
text: If you are executed, the game ends and the Liberals win, with the Communists and the Monarchist. A Bodyguard who is still alive dies in your place, once, but then everyone knows who you are. After the 3rd Fascist policy, every newly elected Chancellor is asked whether they are Hitler, so each election you survive clears your name a little.

details.label: Cannot be radicalised
text: Your membership card says Fascist, so Radicalisation never turns you.

details.label: How to play it
text: Be as Liberal as possible: enact Liberal policies, vote for Liberal governments and let the other Fascists take the risks. You need the trust of the table at the moment it counts, when you are nominated Chancellor after the 3rd Fascist policy.
